text_blocks.snippet: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL) is the world’s largest electric vehicle and energy storage battery manufacturer, holding nearly 40% of the global market share.

list.snippet: Founded: 2011 in Ningde, Fujian Province, China, by Robin Zeng (Zeng Yuqun).
Core Business: Specializes in lithium-ion and sodium-ion batteries for electric vehicles (EVs) and energy storage systems (BESS), plus battery management systems (BMS).
Global Footprint: Operates manufacturing bases and R&D centers worldwide, including sites in Germany, France, Japan, and the United States.
Direct Online Sales: Launched its direct sales platform, CL Mall, selling LFP cells directly from the factory starting at around $63/kWh to streamline energy storage distribution.
Sodium-Ion Mass Shipping: Scaling up mass shipments of sodium-ion batteries, targeting roughly 1 GWh of deliveries.
Quality Warnings: Chairman Robin Zeng warned against the risks of batch battery failures amid a rapid surge of new EV model releases in China.
